This setup aligns with typical August climatology at San Francisco International Airport, where the normal maximum is near 73°F yet sea breezes and fog frequently suppress readings by several degrees. Recent observations, including a 70°F high on August 14, show no heat-wave signals or ridge-driven warming to alter the pattern. Trader positioning at 83.5% implied probability for 68–69°F reflects these stable, observationally supported conditions rather than any anomalous developments.

This market will resolve based on the highest temperature recorded in the 'Daily Observations' table on Weather Underground, not the figure displayed in the 'Day High & Low' summary section; in the event of any discrepancy between the two, the Daily Observations table shall be the primary resolution source not the Day High & Low section.

This market will resolve to the temperature range that contains the highest temperature recorded at the Chengdu Shuangliu International Airport Station in degrees Celsius on 16 Aug '26.

The resolution source for this market will be information from Wunderground, specifically the highest temperature recorded for all times on this day for the Chengdu Shuangliu International Airport Station, available here: https://www.wunderground.com/history/daily/cn/chengdu/ZUUU.

To toggle between Fahrenheit and Celsius, click the gear icon next to the search bar and switch the Temperature setting between °F and °C.

This market can not resolve until the first data point for the following date has been published on the resolution source.

The resolution source for this market measures temperatures to whole degrees Celsius (eg, 9°C). Thus, this is the level of precision that will be used when resolving the market.

Revisions to temperatures recorded within this market's timeframe will be considered until the first datapoint for the following date has been published, after which any alterations will not be considered.

eventMetadata.context_description: Recent ensemble forecasts from global models indicate a likely daily maximum of 32–33°C in Chengdu on August 16, driven by persistent cloud cover and scattered thunderstorms that limit solar heating while promoting evaporative cooling in the humid Sichuan basin environment. Typical August climatology features highs near 30–34°C, with urban heat-island effects and high humidity often moderating peaks; current guidance shows modest instability but no strong subsidence or clear-sky conditions that would support 35°C or higher. Traders weigh the balance between model consensus on these capping factors against the chance of localized clearing that could allow brief warming, with resolution determined by official China Meteorological Administration observations.
